name: Do I need to be home during the exterior painting process?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home during the exterior painting process?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not strictly necessary for you to be home every moment, it's beneficial for you to be available at the start to discuss any final details or concerns, and at the end for the final walkthrough and approval. During the painting process, our team ensures all necessary areas are accessible. We will maintain communication throughout the project, and customers can easily reach us via phone or email for updates or questions. Providing clear instructions regarding access to water and electricity can also streamline the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't need to be home constantly, but being available at the start and end for discussions and final walkthrough is helpful. Ensure access to utilities.
